config.mask_rule_change: The private study A9 masked node j when dt D_j lambda_max <= 0.1, with lambda_max = (4/h^2) cos^2(pi/(2(N+1))). This script masks node j when 4 dt D_j / h^2 <= eta. The two rules differ by the factor cos^2(pi/(2(N+1))) in the cutoff.

residual_conventions.gmres_preconditioned: first k with ||M(b - J x_k)|| <= tol ||M b|| (left preconditioning)
residual_conventions.gmres_true: first k with ||b - J x_k|| <= tol ||b||, same Krylov sequence
